queries.name: orders_by_customer
queries.sql: SELECT o_orderkey, o_totalprice, o_orderdate FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = 137

queries.name: customer_by_mktsegment
queries.sql: SELECT c_custkey, c_name FROM customer WHERE c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING'

queries.name: orders_in_date_range
queries.sql: SELECT o_orderkey, o_totalprice FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o_orderdate < '1995-02-01'

queries.name: lineitem_by_shipdate_returnflag
queries.sql: SELECT l_orderkey, l_extendedprice, l_discount FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1995-01-01' AND l_returnflag = 'R'

queries.name: order_lineitem_join
queries.sql: SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_extendedprice FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O'

queries.name: customer_orders_join
queries.sql: SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = 3

queries.name: part_by_category
queries.sql: SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_retailprice FROM part WHERE p_category = 'ELECTRONICS'

queries.name: lineitem_part_join
queries.sql: SELECT l.l_orderkey, p.p_name FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_category = 'TOOLS'

queries.name: orders_sorted_by_date
queries.sql: SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate FROM orders ORDER BY o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: supplier_by_nation
queries.sql: SELECT s_suppkey, s_name FROM supplier WHERE s_nationkey = 6

queries.name: high_value_orders
queries.sql: SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_totalprice FROM orders WHERE o_totalprice > 400000

queries.name: revenue_by_nation_aggregate
queries.sql: SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey
